title: ADLC business rules (.adlc/knowledge/rules.json)
description: Business values a business user may ask to change (limits, rates, windows). The platform reads the current value from the code, recognises change requests in tickets, applies the edits and proves them with a regression test.

id.description: Rule id, e.g. a spec id like BL-02 or SOW-HIGHLIGHT-DAYS. Unique in the pack.

var.description: Template variable name for playbooks that use this rule (default: id with - replaced by _)

sources.description: Where the CURRENT value lives. The first source that yields a number wins. List the spec and the config/code that must agree.

json.description: JSON files: dotted path to the number

pattern.description: Other files: JavaScript regex with ONE capture group around the number (escape backslashes for JSON)

change.description: Omit for read-only rules. With it, a ticket asking to change the value becomes a change request handled end to end.

template.description: Change id used in branch names (default CR-<id>)

when.description: Regex: words that must appear in the ticket (case-insensitive)

values.description: Regexes with ONE capture group for the requested number; the first number different from the current value is taken

examples: allow up to {{to}} line items per invoice (BL-02)

spec.description: Spec id written into the test header (default: the rule id)

edits.description: Every place the value must change (spec AND code). pattern is a regex; value replaces the match and may use $1 and {{to}}.

optional.description: Skip silently when the file or pattern is missing

regressionTest.description: Template path relative to .adlc/knowledge/ (written to tests.regressionTest for the ticket)

draft.description: true = not used until a person reviews it and removes this flag

source.description: Where this entry came from (generator, AI tool, person)
